changelog.change: Synced tracker with modernization report v2
Completed P0 backlog (HBTV-001/002/004) and closed BLK-001
Started URL modernization by auditing obsolete HTTP/provider URLs and isolating network smoke tests (support task for HBTV-008)
Folded PR #11/#12 documentation updates into PR #10 context, kept HBTV-007 in progress, and tracked JavaFX/JAXB-runtime/network follow-up blockers.
Added JAXB runtime provider wiring and isolated remaining network-dependent HTTP test from default install lifecycle.
Validation found an unrelated blocker at module application/core: compile fails on generated accessor mismatches (isUpdateOnStartup, isAutoriseSnapshot, isDownload/isDeleted family not found).
Completed HBTV-007b and HBTV-007c in PR:13; validated JAXB provider wiring and network test isolation while retaining JavaFX blocker HBTV-007a.

Re-ran Java 8 local validation on PR #13 branch and recorded exact outcomes: validate passes; compile/install stop at application/core accessor mismatch; network-tests verify fails in framework RetrieverUtilsNetworkIT with remote 403.
Aligned JAXB accessor calls with generated getter API and replaced provider-specific network smoke URL with stable example.com test URL.
Added HBTV-008b and BLK-006 for plugin snapshot/build stabilization; kept HBTV-007 in progress and HBTV-007a open.

Migrated runtime updater base URL from dabi legacy host to cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/Mika3578/habitv-repo@main (jsDelivr CDN backed by habitv-repo on GitHub). jsDelivr supports directory listings, satisfying updater HTML anchor discovery. Runtime startup no longer depends on dabiboo.free.fr.
Tracked remaining follow-up to publish plugin/tool artifacts and plugins.txt metadata to habitv-repo for successful startup updates.

Completed provider/plugin audit documentation (docs/plugin-provider-inventory.md) and synchronized risk/testing/url inventories with provider status classifications, URL redirect observations, and test isolation recommendations.
